name: Updates
author: Raj Shimpi
description: One place for every update: Omarchy, system packages (pacman), AUR apps, mise dev tools, git-managed shell plugins and git themes. Checks every few hours, notifies once when something new arrives, and updates only after you confirm, in a terminal you can watch. Plugin updates show their changes first and keep your own local edits.

barWidget.description: Pending OS, app, dev tool, plugin and theme updates, with confirm-before-update
